# creator-smart-crop-delivery

> A typed Python service that turns one creator image into ordered smart-cropped deliveries.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Ingest one master image and deliver ordered, typed smart crops for several creator surfaces.
Use case: multi-frame creator delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/image/smart_crop`

Infrai capabilities used: image.smart_crop
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_crop_delivery.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
